We are looking for a Site Manager (f/m/d) to join our team at Innomotics.
The Industry-Leader of Motors and Drives
Innomotics is an industry-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world’s most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the #EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.
Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People
We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best-in-class, we want you IN.
Your Future Role
Responsibilities
As a
Site Manager
responsible for the Project Management activities within
Systems and Solutions Division Türkiye
, you will leverage your high‑level expertise in automation, electrification and digitalization solutions for heavy industries. This role will be leading site activities of assigned Electrification and Automation project in Cement and Mining industries. Site Manager will be responsible for the technical and commercial success of the project during erection and commissioning phases on site. This relates in particular to:
Responsibility for leadership duties at a work site and all associated tasks.
Ensuring proper execution of field installation, assembly and commissioning services (in terms of technical, economic and quality concerns) to fulfil the business’ project execution obligations in a professional and safe manner, on time & to budget.
In This Role, You Will
Manages the assigned activities within the defined time and quality framework.
Complies with the requirements of the Innomotics Project Management Plan with particular emphasis on timely and accurate reporting.
Works to procedures and requirements concerning quality management (audits, test seals, acceptance checks) according to valid Quality Management regulations and standards
Monitors continuously the project status, early identification of discrepancies and initiates targeted actions
Documents all work results according to the valid document management standards
Ensures that EHS best practice is implemented on all work sites
Actively promotes the Innomotics Zero Harm initiative
Identifies and assesses all risk factors utilizing appropriate risk measurement tools
Devises suitable strategies for risk mitigation (elimination, reduction)
Implement procedure for solving issues and problems (identification, analysis, actions and controlling) with all necessary internal and external partners
Identifies and minimizes non-conformance costs
Supports the project team in the identification and documenting of claims
Puts the strategy for making/mitigating claims rigorously into practice
At an early stage, informs customer, management and project team of scope deviations
At an early stage, identifies and mitigates external claims
Rigorously monitors the performance of the subcontractors, conducts timely escalation (in the event of qualitative shortfalls and problems in cooperation) and, where there are any discrepancies, initiates suitable timely action
Manages project obligations within the defined financial targets (budget, target costing, target profit)
Initiates invoicing according to project progress
Support the project in optimizing the project cash flow and assets
Properly manages customer expectations.
Ensures efficient communication with all relevant stakeholders
Ensures targeted and full communication within the site team
Your profile.
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Electrical-Electronics Engineering. (MBA is an advantage)
At least 5 years of experience as a Site Manager with full responsibility in industrial (preferably in cement and mining), energy and infrastructure projects.
Working knowledge of instrumentation, process automation systems, MV & LV electrical switchgear systems, transformers, diesel generators, UPS & installations
Strong technical understanding of Automation, Electrification and Drives & Motors systems.
Has successful experience of working in teams made up of international members
Experience with complex projects varying in size required.
Ability to combine strategic thinking with detailed execution
Strong team collaboration and leadership mindset
Solid organizational skills including attention to details, multi-tasking skills, advanced time management and analytical skills.
Strong communication skills and customer focus.
To be proactive, taking initiative, defining actions, and getting things done.
Ability to meet demanding schedule requirements without compromising quality and EHS.
IT Knowledge: computer literate with a good knowledge of Autocad, Primavera and Microsoft Office tools particularly Excel, Word and Microsoft Project.
Willingness to travel nationally and internationally
Fluent English communication skills
What’s IN It For You (Our Benefits)
A competitive salary package, including performance-based bonuses and benefits.
Opportunities for professional development and career progression within a leading global company.
A collaborative and dynamic team environment focused on innovation and excellence.
